reviewedThrough.scope: Retained functionality. Removed providers, media, Pi UI, and model-assisted features are excluded.

intentionalDifferences: Project-scoped options replace global configuration and environment credentials.
Request-local network policy replaces the process-global fetch wrapper.
RSC recovery has fixed work, depth and generated-text limits. Malformed HTML tag scans advance without repeated suffix searches.
Conversation-scoped snapshots replace Pi session persistence and cache files.
Public GitHub access only. Browser-cookie authentication and private repository authentication are excluded.
Evidence passages are unassessed. No model-based truth verification is performed.
Explicit providers are strict. Authentication, configuration, unsupported requests and caller cancellation never trigger fallback.
Provider filters are not silently converted into query hints.
Pi UI, media, model-assisted modes, provider fan-out, unused providers and standalone MCP server distribution are removed.
dependencyPolicy: Direct parser versions originate from the v0.46.0 resolved lock. The workspace package-lock.json pins the installed dependency tree. Security exceptions require a recorded motivating fix.

dependencyExceptions.reason: Minimum 8.x security release covering applicable TLS renegotiation and excessive content-encoding failures.
dependencyExceptions.review: Motivating patches, selected runtime changes, package manifests and install hooks reviewed. Not a complete commit or bundled parser audit.
